title: UwU Resource Pack
description: This resource pack replaces block textures. It replaces all block textures with "UwU," as well as armor, boats, etc. But it's not finished yet ;)
body:
This resource pack replaces block textures.

It replaces all block textures with "UwU," as well as armor, boats, etc.
But it's not finished yet ;) 

Experience Minecraft in a completely new, cute style. More updates and features are coming soon!
